items.title: Show HN: Semble – Code search for agents that uses 98% fewer tokens than grep
items.whyItMatters: 98% token reduction on code search is a real loop-cost win — worth dropping into any agent that currently greps large repos.

items.title: We stopped AI bot spam in our GitHub repo using Git's –author flag
items.whyItMatters: Simple, already-available lever for any OSS maintainer drowning in AI-generated bot PRs — no infra required.

items.title: Apple Silicon costs more than OpenRouter
items.whyItMatters: Concrete energy/cost numbers for local vs cloud inference — the gap is narrower than most assume once idle power is factored in.

items.title: Anthropic acquires Stainless
items.whyItMatters: Stainless generates typed SDK wrappers — bringing that in-house likely means tighter API versioning and faster multi-language SDK releases.

items.title: I don't think AI will make your processes go faster
items.whyItMatters: The constraint is usually coordination overhead, not raw compute — solid stress-test for anyone selling AI as a throughput multiplier.
